templates.paylines: Wins pay left to right from reel 1 along {lines} fixed lines. Each line pays its best reading once, and every line is bet on every spin — the total stake is {units} times the line bet.
templates.clusters: There are no lines, and no reading across the reels. {minimum} or more of the same symbol touching each other — up, down, left or right, never diagonally — pay as one group, anywhere on the grid. One big group is worth far more than two small ones.
templates.ways: There are no lines. A symbol pays if it lands anywhere on each reel starting from reel 1, and every path through those positions is paid — {ways} of them on a full grid. Several symbols can pay at once.
templates.ways_shifting: There are no lines. A symbol pays if it lands anywhere on each reel starting from reel 1, and every path through those positions is paid, so a taller grid is worth more. Several symbols can pay at once.
templates.shifting_reels: Every reel is dealt a fresh height of {min} to {max} rows each spin. Taller reels carry more symbols and multiply the paths through them, so the size of the win is settled before the reels stop.
templates.cascades: Winning symbols are removed and the ones above fall into the gaps, refilling from the top. If the new grid wins, it happens again — up to {steps} times in one spin. The chain multiplies as it runs: {ladder}. Everything the chain pays belongs to the one spin that started it.
templates.wilds: The {wild} substitutes for any paying symbol{expansion}. It never stands in for the {scatter}, which has to land on its own.
templates.wilds_expanded: and fills its whole reel during free spins
templates.scatters: The {scatter} pays from anywhere on the grid — it does not have to line up, and it is what opens the free spins.
templates.refining: The free spins get better as they run. Each one burns the next symbol off every reel for good — the {burned} — so by the last spin the strips hold only what pays well.
templates.shapes: You choose how the run goes before the first free spin: {shapes}. Both are worth the same to the credit, so the choice is how the return arrives rather than how much of it there is — the short one pays nothing more often, and far more when it does.
templates.hoard: Hoard symbols fill the meter beside the reels. At {capacity} it hatches and deals a board of {board} chests: keep picking until {blanks} come up empty, and every prize is a share of the hoard. A full board is worth about {value}% of what the meter holds.
templates.jackpots: {contribution}% of every stake feeds the four pots, which can pay at random on any paid spin. A bigger stake wins them proportionally more often, so the return per credit is the same at every bet — worth {rtp}% of all play.{shared}
templates.jackpots_shared: The {names} is shared by every cabinet.
templates.wrath: {trigger} dragon eggs on one grid wake the dragon. The eggs lock as coins worth {mean}x the total bet on average and you get {respins} respins; every coin that lands restores them in full, so the round only ends when nothing does. Fill all {cells} cells for {multiple}x the total bet on top.
templates.seam: {trigger} of one paying symbol opens a seam and the reels stop. You pick what it does over the next {steps} moves — {rites} — and it never touches wilds, scatters or eggs. The board is then read again and you keep what the seam added, up to {multiple}x the bet.
templates.gamble: Any win can be staked on a coin: double it or lose it, up to {steps} times in a row{half}. The odds are exactly even, so gambling changes nothing about what the machine returns over time — only how far it swings. Wins above {ceiling}x the total bet cannot be gambled.
templates.gamble_half: , or risk half and keep the rest
templates.ante: The ante stakes {cost}x the usual bet and weaves extra scatters into the first reel, so the free spins arrive about twice as often. Its price was measured from what those features are worth, so the return is unchanged. It buys a shorter wait, not an edge.
templates.feature_buy: You can pay for a feature outright rather than wait for it — {tiers} of them, from {cheapest}x the total bet. Each price is set from what the feature is actually worth, at the same {rtp}% return the cabinet pays anyway, so buying is neither a shortcut nor a tax. It only trades waiting for volatility.
templates.rite_enrich_one: climbs a place up the paytable
templates.rite_gild: multiplies what the board already pays
templates.free_spin_awards: Free spins are awarded by the scatters: {table}.
templates.free_spin_multiplier: Everything they pay is multiplied by {multiplier}.
templates.free_spin_retrigger: Landing the scatters again during the feature adds more.
templates.free_spin_close: A free spin costs nothing and is part of the round that bought it, at the same bet.
